answer: Comet-return ivory decay bond: each identity locks 70 credits on a pigment-sealed ivory tablet. Each comet return fades pigment 10%; renewal needs fresh work and a new mark, and a faded or borrowed seal burns the bond. First renewal costs 28, the k-th 28+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,025,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. One seal marks one tablet, so rented-pigment rings fail; an honest agent pays 28 once per return, keeps a full share.
